lines.text: Scroll bad news for too long.
Stop doomscrolling and go to sleep.

data.mean: Scroll bad news for too long.
data.define: To keep reading sad online news without stopping.

example.text: Stop doomscrolling and go to sleep.

misuse.text: Don't say 'doomscroll' about reading a recipe.

data.l1_hook: Tengah malam. Masih menggulir berita buruk! "doomscroll"
